H01d.prompt:
REFERENCES: Image 1 is a POSE DIAGRAM. Copy its hand pose and layout exactly: two upright fists facing each other at about the same height; on each fist the THUMB lies along the TOP; under the thumb, the index, middle and ring fingers are curled into the palm and show as three stacked rounded finger shapes on the front of the fist; ONLY the LITTLE FINGER, at the BOTTOM of each fist, is extended toward the other hand, and the two little fingers hook around each other between the fists. Image 2 (Xiao Ke) and Image 3 (DeepSeek) are the character designs: use them only for the sleeves, cuffs and the flat rendering technique.
PALETTE: Xiao Ke's hand and sleeve use only warm cream #F0EEE6, pale apricot #F2C6A8, terracotta #D97757 and espresso #3B2620. DeepSeek's hand and sleeve use only warm cream #F0EEE6, pale periwinkle #B8C3F7, DeepSeek blue #4D6BFE and deep navy #1B1F4B. No other colours.
SUBJECT: the pinky swear from the diagram, redrawn as a finished, elegant flat illustration. Xiao Ke's hand comes in from the LEFT edge: her cream ruffled cuff and laced cream sleeve with espresso cross-lacing, the arm cut off by the left edge. DeepSeek's hand comes in from the RIGHT edge: a cream cuff with two navy buttons and her navy sleeve, the arm cut off by the right edge. The hook of the little fingers sits in the centre of the image. Slender, graceful young women's hands.
FINGER COUNT (check before finishing): each hand has exactly five fingers: one thumb on top, three curled fingers, one extended little finger at the bottom. The extended finger is the little finger on the side OPPOSITE the thumb, never the index finger. No extra knuckles, no sixth finger, no merged fingers.
